sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:62

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:62:1
items.html: We call “Aba” both Aba and Israel Saba, since both of them are the Bina of MA: For the upper Aba is the Keter and Hochma of the Bina of MA, and Israel Saba is the ZA of the Bina of MA, as above, see there.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:62:2
items.html: And Ima — Bina and Tevuna, since both of them are only the aspect of BON, which is the Nukva: For the upper Ima, called Bina, is the five Sefirot: Gevura, Tifferet and NHY of the Bina of BON, and Tevuna is the Malchut of the Bina of BON. And they are so called only at the time when the upper AVI and YESHSUT unite into a single Partzuf, for then the four pairs above become two pairs. The first and third pairs become one, and both are called by the name of Aba alone, and they clothe AA from the throat to the Tabur. And the second and fourth pairs also become one, and both are called by the name of Ima alone, and she clothes AA on the left side, from the throat to the Tabur.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:62:3
items.html:
The coupling of YESHSUT is a coupling that never ceases, as is known, and is called the coupling of Bina and Bina, as above. But “Aba is not in the city” refers to Hochma with Bina, which is the upper AVI, whose coupling does cease: And this does not contradict what is written in Etz Chaim, Gate 14, Chapter 2, and in many places, that the coupling of the upper AVI, too, never ceases forever. For these names of AVI and YESHSUT are not fixed, but one must always understand them according to the subject at hand.
For we have explained above that the two pairs — the third and the fourth — which clothe AA from the Chazeh and below, on the right and on the left, down to the Tabur, are called YESHSUT. And the two upper pairs — the first and the second — which clothe AA from His throat and below, on the right and on the left, down to the Chazeh, are called the upper AVI. Now, so it is for the most part. However, at the time when they speak of the two upper pairs in themselves, the first pair is regarded as the upper AVI, namely, those that clothe AA from His right. And the second pair, which clothe AA from the Chazeh and upward, on His left, are called by the name of YESHSUT. This is because both of the first pair are of Hochma: the male is the Hochma of the Bina of MA, and the female is the true Hochma of BON. And therefore they are called the upper AVI. And the second pair, since both of them are of Bina — the male being the Bina of the Bina of MA, and the female being the five lower Sefirot of the Bina of BON — both are therefore called by the name of YESHSUT. And in like manner, at the time when they speak of the upper AVI having risen to the aspect of AA Himself, namely, that they attained the stature of the Hochma of MA, like AA — then all the four pairs above that clothe the body of AA, from the throat to the Tabur, are called by the name of YESHSUT, that is, in relation to the upper AVI, who have the stature of the Hochma of MA; for even the first pair is also the aspect of YESHSUT, since they have only the stature of the Bina of MA, because even the male of the first pair has only Hochma from the aspect of the stature of Bina, and not true Hochma. And it is known that the main thing is the stature of the male. Therefore all four pairs together are now called by the name of YESHSUT, and only the upper AVI, who have the stature of the Hochma of MA, are alone called at this time by the name of the upper AVI.
And therefore the ARI was careful to precisely explain in which discernments of AVI and YESHSUT he speaks, for he says, “Hochma with Bina, which is the upper AVI,” namely, that at the time when the upper AVI rise to the level of AA, the coupling is then called by the name of the coupling of Hochma with Bina, because Aba now has the stature of the Hochma of MA and bestows to the Hochma of BON, called Bina, because she is of BON. But those AVI that clothe the body of AA, from the throat and below, since they have only the stature of the Bina of MA, their coupling is called the coupling of Bina with Bina; for even Aba of the first pair has only the Keter and Hochma of the Bina of MA, and the Hochma of Bina is also the aspect of Bina. And therefore the female, who is the VAK of the true Hochma of BON, is not revealed at all in this coupling, but only in the measure of the male is she revealed, which is the Yod of the name HaVaYaH, as above.
And this is what he said, “And with this you will understand what is said elsewhere, on ‘Aba is not in the city, etc.’” It refers to what is written in Etz Chaim, Gate 15, Chapter 1 (and see at the end of the Gate of the General Principles, copied from the manuscript of the ARI himself), where he brings what our sages expounded on the verse “Aba is not in the city, etc.”: “God swore that He will not enter the Jerusalem above, which is the coupling of AVI, until He enters the Jerusalem below, which is an entirely complete coupling of ZON. And so on, for a complete coupling, which is the coupling of AVI in the aspect of Hochma, that is, the points, ceased due to our sins from the days of the destruction. And so on. However, a coupling that is not complete, which is to renew old souls or to sustain the worlds, this coupling never ceases.” End of quote.
And now there is an apparent contradiction, for there he wrote that the coupling of the upper AVI in the aspect of Hochma ceased completely from the days of the destruction onward, and here he writes that they do couple at times, except that their coupling ceases. But these and those are the words of the living God, only one must go down to the depth of the matter. And first one must understand the reason why the coupling of the upper AVI, in the aspect of the Hochma within them, truly ceased, and what the oath is, that the upper AVI should be dependent on an entirely complete coupling of ZON; and on the contrary, ZON are always dependent on the upper AVI, who complete ZON, who are their children. And how can it be that ZON are completed before the upper AVI are completed? And to understand all this, one must know and learn these matters from their source.
And one must remember all the three divisions that were in the world of Nekudim, which were explained above (page 624, the passage beginning “And with this you will understand”): division one is the choicest of all, namely, what came out there from the substance of their own emanation, which is the aspect of the AVI in back to back, in which the nullification and the breaking did not touch even a little, and this is entirely the portion of Atik. And division two is what came out there in the aspect of addition, from the illumination of the Tabur of AK, which lowered the bottom Hey from the Einayim to the Peh of Nekudim, and the upper AVI returned to the Rosh and attained their GAR; this division is much worse than division one, because of the nullification that was in them at the time of the breaking of the vessels. And now, from this second division, the GAR of Atzilut — which are AA, the upper AVI and YESHSUT — were corrected; but ZON could not be corrected from this division, except by VAK alone. And this is because this division still has no part of the substance of the bottom Hey in it at all, but only from the aspects of the vessels of SAG, which received the power of the bottom Hey into them. And division three is the worst of all, which is what came out there by the MAN of the Vav and the point of the Yesod of AK, by which the upper AVI returned face to face, and from this MAN the seven lower ones of Nekudim came out, which broke face and back, died, and descended to BYA. And even the Mochin that came out of them in the upper AVI, called the look of the eyes of the upper AVI, and so on, their nullification, too, is most severe, because the substance of the bottom Hey is in them, namely, the point that they received from the Yesod of AK. Study it there well.
And with this you will understand the distinction between the Mochin that are fixed in Atzilut, whose coupling never ceases forever, and the Mochin that are not fixed and do not exist constantly, but are dependent on the deeds of the lower ones, that when they are worthy they cause Mochin and coupling, and when they are not worthy the coupling immediately ceases. For at first, only the choicest was corrected in Atzilut — division one, which Atik took, and division two, which AA, the upper AVI and YESHSUT of Atzilut took. And since their nullification, which happened to them at the time of the kings, was not severe — for in truth they had no share at all in the kings, since the upper AVI came out there only in the aspect of face in the back, and from this coupling nothing reaches ZON, as written there — but because they were attached to the Mochin of division three, which came out by the MAN of the Yesod of AK, therefore they too were nullified. And since the nullification was not because of themselves, therefore, after they were corrected by the new MA and returned to be in the aspect of GAR, namely, AA, the upper AVI and YESHSUT, they remained so permanently, and their coupling never ceases forever, as the ARI wrote in Etz Chaim, Gate 14, Chapter 2, that the coupling of AA and the upper AVI never ceases forever.
However, all the Mochin that come out by the MAN that the lower ones raise from division three — which are the four posteriors of the upper AVI and YESHSUT, and the sparks and vessels of the seven kings, from the aspect of what came out of their source, the Vav and the point of the Yesod of AK, whose nullification and breaking is most severe, because the substance of the bottom Hey is mixed in them, as above — these Mochin and couplings that come out by their power cannot be fixed permanently in a coupling that never ceases, for then the lower ones would flaw even the GAR of Atzilut; and therefore they cease at the time of the flaw of the lower ones. In such a way that they are entirely dependent on the lower ones, for these Mochin do not come out in Atzilut without MAN that the lower ones raise at the time when they are worthy; and this is the cause that when they are not worthy, the coupling and the Mochin are cut off from them. However, the first fixed Mochin, which were corrected from division two, are not in need of the raising of the MAN by the lower ones, for the lower ones have no connection to them whatsoever, since even ZON could receive from them only the aspect of VAK alone, without a Rosh and Mochin, and all the more so the souls of the lower ones, which are dependent on and come out of ZON. But they were corrected and came out by the ascents of the screen and its refinement, in the manner of the exit of the Partzufim of AK, as explained above. Understand and remember this well.
And with what has been said, you will also understand the meaning of the ascents of the Partzufim above their level, which is customary on Shabbatot and holidays and by the good deeds of the righteous; for the levels of each Partzuf were fixed according to what was corrected by the MAN of division two. Atik was corrected in the stature of Keter, AA in the stature of Hochma, the upper AVI in the stature of Bina, and ZON in a body without a head. That is, according to the statures that came out, each one below the other, called the ten Sefirot of the new MA, as above at length. However, this is still not a complete correction, for the levels that BON had at the time of the kings have not yet been restored through this. For in relation to what they had then, all the Partzufim of Atzilut are regarded as lacking GAR; for example, the upper AVI, which are the second and third points of the GAR of Nekudim, whose place was then in the place of the Rosh of the Atik of Atzilut (as above, page 627, the passage beginning “And the cause”) — now, in Atzilut, they descended to the aspects of YESHSUT of Atzilut, and they lack three degrees: Neshama, Haya, Yechida, until they return to their place, to the GAR of Nekudim. For when YESHSUT and the upper AVI unite into a single Partzuf, YESHSUT acquire the aspect of Neshama, and this is regarded as YESHSUT rising to the level of the upper AVI. And when YESHSUT rise to the level of AA, they then acquire their aspect of Haya; and when YESHSUT rise to the level of Atik — at which time they are in the place of the GAR of Nekudim, as they were at first — they then acquire their Yechida. For now they have returned to their level, as they were at the time of the kings, when they were included in the second and third points of Nekudim, like the AVI of Nekudim. Thus, before their ascent they are found to be lacking GAR, and likewise all the Partzufim of Atzilut.
And now, these Mochin of Neshama, Haya and Yechida, which the Partzufim acquire, come by the raising of the MAN from the good deeds of the righteous; and this MAN is sorted out from the lights, sparks and vessels of division three above. And therefore they are called only ascents, and not actual clothing, because these Mochin are not fixed in them, but they rise and fall according to the deeds of the lower ones, as above; and therefore they are not regarded as clothing, but only a mere ascent, that is, for that moment alone. Namely, at the time when the lower ones are worthy and raise MAN from the sparks and vessels that fell into BYA, which pertain to the aspect of Neshama, to the Partzufim of ZON — then ZON too sort from the posteriors of YESHSUT, which are in Atzilut, and raise them as MAN to the upper AVI for the sake of YESHSUT; and likewise the upper AVI raise MAN for AA, to the Partzuf of Atik; and so upward. And then the male waters descend, which are the Mochin, from above to the Partzuf of Atik, and Atik attains the aspect of the GAR of the level above him; and afterwards Atik and his Nukva couple and bestow Mochin to AA, and AA too attains the GAR from the level above him, namely, from the aspect of Atik. And afterwards AA and his Nukva couple and bestow Mochin to the upper AVI, and they too attain the GAR from the level above them, namely, from AA. And after this, the upper AVI couple and bestow Mochin to YESHSUT, and YESHSUT too attain the GAR from the level above them, namely, from the upper AVI. And then YESHSUT also couple and bestow Mochin to ZON, and ZON too attain the GAR from the level above them, namely, from YESHSUT. And then ZON also couple and bestow Mochin to the souls of the righteous, who raised the MAN to ZON, and were the cause of all these new Mochin that came out in all the Partzufim of Atzilut. And these new Mochin, which the Partzufim attained, each from his preceding level, are called ascents. For ZON, which attained GAR from YESHSUT, are regarded as having risen and clothed them; and YESHSUT, which attained GAR from the level of the upper AVI, are regarded as having risen and clothed them; and likewise the upper AVI to AA, AA to Atik, and Atik to what is above him, to the end of the levels.
And if the lower ones are worthy even more, and raise MAN to ZON from the sparks and vessels in BYA that pertain to the aspect of Haya — then ZON too raise MAN to the upper AVI, from the aspect of the Haya of YESHSUT; and likewise each one raises to his superior, as above. And afterwards MAD descends from above, and Atik attains new Mochin, which are from two levels higher than his own level; and likewise all the Partzufim. And it is now found that the upper AVI attained GAR from the aspect of Atik, YESHSUT attained GAR from the aspect of AA, and ZON attained GAR from the aspect of the upper AVI; and all the Partzufim acquire the aspect of the Mochin of Haya, namely, the light of Hochma.
And when the lower ones are worthy completely, they then raise MAN to ZON from the sparks and vessels in BYA that pertain to the aspect of the light of Yechida; and likewise all the Partzufim of Atzilut, each one to his superior, until new Mochin descend to Atik that are higher than him by three levels; and likewise each one of the Partzufim of Atzilut. And it is now regarded that YESHSUT attained the GAR from three levels above them, namely, from Atik; and it is said that YESHSUT rose and clothed Atik. And likewise ZON attained the GAR from the third level above them, namely, from AA; and it is said that ZA rose and clothed AA. And then ZON couple and bestow the new Mochin to the souls of the lower ones, from the level of Yechida, since they are the main cause of all the Partzufim of Atzilut attaining the lights of Yechida, as above. And you now see that all the Partzufim were completed and came to their first place, where they were at the time of the kings. For YESHSUT came to the place of the Atik of Atzilut, which clothes the GAR of Nekudim, where these YESHSUT of Atzilut were included and standing at the time of the kings, before they were broken. And likewise ZA, who has now risen and clothed AA, which clothes the place of HGT of Nekudim — it is now found that ZA too returned to his place, where he was at the time of the kings, before they were broken. And therefore all the Partzufim are now regarded as being in completeness, and their coupling in completeness — that is, as they were before the flaw and the breaking of the vessels.
Now you will understand the meaning of the words “complete coupling” and “coupling that is not complete.” For there are three divisions here: division one is the couplings of the Partzufim from the aspect of the GAR that are fixed in Atzilut, in which ZON remained as a body without a head, except that they had the correction of back to back, as above. And now, even the GAR — which are AA, the upper AVI and YESHSUT — are regarded here, in relation to the Nekudim, as lacking three degrees, as above; and therefore their couplings are called the aspect of a coupling that is not at all complete, for they cannot bestow any Mochin to ZON. And therefore these couplings are called a coupling to sustain the worlds, in the aspect of restricted vitality, but not to beget souls for ZON, as explained.
Division two is the couplings of the Partzufim at the time of their ascent to their superior — namely, at the time when the lower ones are worthy and raise MAN to ZON, and this MAN causes new GAR Mochin to all the Partzufim of Atzilut, and each one rises and clothes above his level. With the MAN that is attributed to the light of Neshama, each one rises one level above; with the MAN attributed to the light of Haya, each one rises two levels above his level; and with the MAN attributed to the Mochin of Yechida, each one rises three levels above his level. And now, all these couplings can be called a complete coupling, since by these couplings the GAR Mochin of ZON are born, which is called bequeathing crowns to their sons. This is unlike division one, where their coupling suffices only to sustain ZON in the aspect of Ruach Nefesh alone, and they cannot bestow Mochin, as above. However, when we evaluate them with respect to the Mochin and the couplings that were theirs at the time of the kings, they are still regarded as incomplete, for even at the time when they attain the Mochin of Yechida — at which time, in truth, each one is already in his place, as in Nekudim before the breaking of the vessels — nevertheless, since they attain this only by way of ascent, meaning that it is not fixed and lasting, it is not regarded as a complete correction, since they are destined to descend from there. And from this evaluation, the couplings of these Partzufim are called a coupling that is not complete, even at the time when they attain the Mochin of Yechida and YESHSUT clothe Atik and ZA clothes AA, because they are not permanent.
Division three is at the end of correction, namely, that the Partzufim of Atzilut will remain in the Mochin of Yechida permanently, and they will have no descent anymore; at which time they are regarded as being corrected completely, and as having returned to their level, as they were before the flaw and the breaking of the vessels; at which time the couplings are regarded in the aspect of an entirely complete coupling.
And now the three divisions in the matter of complete coupling and non-complete coupling have been well explained: division one is a coupling that is not complete in two aspects: one, they are lacking GAR in relation to the Nekudim; and two, no Mochin are born from their couplings. And division two is superior to division one, for their couplings beget Mochin for ZON, which is why they can be called a complete coupling; but in relation to the Nekudim they are regarded as a coupling that is not complete, for they have not yet received their correction in completeness. Rather, only division three — namely, as it will be at the end of correction, when they return to their level in complete permanence, as they were at the time of the Nekudim — then they are regarded as the aspect of an entirely complete coupling, for they received all their correction in completeness.
And you see that the matter of complete coupling and non-complete coupling applies to all the Partzufim of Atzilut, and not specifically to the upper AVI and YESHSUT; and they are all equal in this matter. For at the time when ZON are in division one, all the Partzufim are regarded as not complete, like them. And likewise, when they are in division two: if ZON attain Neshama, all the upper Partzufim attain the aspect of Neshama, too; and when ZON attain the aspect of Haya, they all attain the aspect of Haya; and likewise with Yechida. Except that the matter of the raising of the MAN begins from below upward, and in this, ZON precede the upper AVI; and in the matter of the descent of the MAD, the upper AVI are the cause for ZON, for it begins from above downward.
And now the gate is opened to understand the words of the ARI concerning the oath: “God swore that He will not enter the Jerusalem above, which is the coupling of AVI, until He enters the Jerusalem below, which is an entirely complete coupling of ZON; for a complete coupling, which is the coupling of AVI in the aspect of Hochma, that is, the points, ceased due to our sins.” And you see that the ARI speaks here of an entirely complete coupling of ZON and the upper AVI, namely, as they were at the time of the Nekudim; for this reason he is precise to say “the coupling of AVI in the aspect of Hochma, which are the points,” that is, as they were at the time of the Nekudim. And therefore he says that this coupling ceased completely, meaning that they will no longer be in this aspect, but only at the end of correction. And he therefore explains the oath: that the Creator swore that before ZON are corrected completely, and there is an entirely complete coupling in the Jerusalem below, which is ZON, the complete coupling will cease even from the upper AVI, who are the aspect of the Jerusalem above. And the reason for its dependence on ZON is that the main cause of the correction is from below upward, by the good deeds and the MAN that the lower ones raise; and ZON are therefore found to precede the upper AVI. But in the descent of the MAD and the Mochin, certainly the upper AVI precede ZON, and ZON are dependent on the upper AVI, as above.
However, here, in the words of the ARI before us, he interprets the verse “Aba is not in the city” with regard to permanence, namely, that the Creator swore that He will not enter permanently into the Jerusalem above, before He enters permanently into the Jerusalem below. And this is what he said: “The coupling of YESHSUT is a coupling that never ceases, and is called the coupling of Bina and Bina. But ‘Aba is not in the city’ refers to Hochma with Bina, whose coupling ceases.” And you see that the ARI speaks here of division two, namely, the GAR Mochin that the Partzufim of Atzilut attain by the raising of the MAN of the lower ones to ZON; and he speaks of the first ascent, which is by the MAN attributed to Neshama, when the upper AVI attain one level higher than their level, namely, AA, which is regarded as the upper AVI rising to AA, as above; at which time Aba has the stature of Hochma, and it is called the coupling of Hochma with Bina, as above — which is the aspect of new Mochin of Neshama for all the Partzufim, as above. And he says that this is what the Creator swore — “Aba is not in the city” — for this coupling is not permanent, and it is a coupling that ceases, because it is dependent on the deeds of the lower ones, as above. And only the Mochin of YESHSUT, which are all the four pairs of the upper AVI that clothe the body of AA, from the throat to the Tabur, are all in the aspect of a coupling that never ceases, since they are the aspects of the Mochin fixed in Atzilut, which were not corrected by the raising of the MAN of the lower ones, as above. And therefore their coupling never ceases. However, their coupling is regarded as not complete, in two aspects: one, they are lacking GAR in relation to the Nekudim; and two, they are not fit to beget souls and GAR for ZON, and all their coupling is only to sustain the worlds.
The conclusion of our words is that there are two aspects of complete coupling: one is a fully complete coupling, meaning as it was before the breaking of the vessels, and it ceased completely until the end of correction. Two is a complete coupling by way of ascent, and it is not completely cut off, but it rises and falls according to the deeds of the lower ones, and is therefore sometimes called a coupling that is not complete. Three is a coupling that is entirely not complete, which is only to sustain the worlds, and it is a coupling that never ceases forever.
